correctness.rationale: The universal proof constructs the staircase uniquely up to reversal; a three-variable proper-neighborhood-inclusion formula and its recursively defined rank separate all levels. At each level there are two twin classes, whose clipped sizes are definable using at most k variables via pairwise twin predicates with local shadowing. Any unequal rank-pair breaks the global side symmetry; a common-neighbor formula propagates its orientation. Conversely a k-pebble strategy preserving class and equality survives indefinitely. Burnside fixed strings count k^m. Finite programs reproduce 819 graph-structure cases and 524 logical-refinement graph instances with sharpness checks. No infinite conclusion is inferred from finite checks.

value.rationale: The theorem produces a complete classification for every unbounded staircase length m and every k>=3, a sharp truncation threshold, canonical smallest representatives, the exact family-wide count (k^(2m)+k^m)/2 of theories at m levels, and a strict variable hierarchy. The nontrivial global side-orientation recovery in the pure adjacency signature makes this more than a direct textbook inference from a labelled partition. It applies to all connected Ferrers graphs, including those with induced P4 and arbitrarily many neighborhood levels.
